summary: Lead research for Eligibility Lite MVP (lightweight benefits eligibility screening tool). Targets county JFS offices, community action agencies, and social services organizations that need a simple, quick eligibility screening tool for SNAP, Medicaid, and other assistance programs.

leads.fit_rationale: State-run self-assessment tool for benefits eligibility. A lightweight, localized version could serve specific county needs with faster load times and simplified interface.

leads.organization: Ashtabula County Department of Job and Family Services
leads.fit_rationale: Determines eligibility for food stamps, Medicaid, OWF, and childcare assistance. A lite screening tool would reduce intake workload and help residents quickly understand potential eligibility.
Provides SNAP eligibility calculations for Ohio residents. Lightweight eligibility tools could complement their existing calculator with multi-program screening.
Helps residents access assistance programs. Eligibility screening tools would help their clients quickly identify which programs to apply for.
Connects residents with social services. A lite eligibility screener embedded in their platform would help direct clients to appropriate resources faster.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Create one-page eligibility questionnaire with instant results.
Include visual progress indicator showing how close to eligibility.
Add plain-language explanations of why someone may/may not qualify.
Provide next-step guidance with links to application portals.
Include document checklist based on selected programs.
Add print-friendly summary for caseworker consultations.
Create mobile-optimized design for smartphone users.
Include privacy notice explaining no personal data is stored.

possible_issues: Eligibility tools must feel trustworthy and official—unprofessional design undermines credibility.
Dense legal language intimidates users who need simple answers.
Without clear visual feedback, users may not understand their results.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Lightweight eligibility tools are highly white-labelable for county JFS offices, community action agencies, and healthcare navigators with custom branding.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
Contact Ashtabula County DJFS about embedding lite screening tool.
Reach out to 211 Ashtabula about integration opportunities.
Explore partnership with ACCAA for client intake optimization.
